message.text:
h11.

`store.User` is referenced from the most packages outside the data layer, with `store.Memo` second.

**Answer: 1st: `store.User` (`store/user.go:29`) — 7 packages outside `store/` (6 excluding the test-only package), ~99 references; 2nd: `store.Memo` (`store/memo.go:35`) — 6 packages (4 excluding test-only ones), ~73 references**

Method: I enumerated the entity structs declared in the `store` package (`store/user.go:29`, `store/memo.go:35`, `store/attachment.go:16`, `store/reaction.go:7`, `store/inbox.go:24`, `store/memo_relation.go:16`, `store/memo_share.go:6`, `store/user_identity.go:8`, `store/idp.go:12`, `store/user_setting.go:13`, `store/instance_setting.go:14`), then counted qualified `store.<Type>` references per directory across `server/`, `internal/`, and `cmd/`, excluding the whole `store/` tree (the data layer itself, including `store/db/*`, `store/cache`, `store/test`) and the generated `proto/gen` code.

Full ranking by referencing package count:

| Type | Packages | Non-test packages | References |
|---|---|---|---|
| `User` | 7 | 6 | ~99 |
| `Memo` | 6 | 4 | ~73 |
| `Attachment` | 4 | 3 | ~43 |
| `Inbox` | 3 | 2 | ~14 |
| `MemoRelation` | 3 | 1 | ~10 |
| `MemoShare` | 3 | 2 | ~10 |
| `Reaction` | 2 | 1 | ~14 |
| `UserIdentity` | 2 | 1 | ~9 |

The referencing packages:

- `store.User`: `server/auth`, `server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss`, plus the test-only `server/router/api/v1/test`. Heaviest users are `server/router/api/v1/user_service.go` (8), `server/auth/authenticator.go` (6), `server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go` and `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go` (5 each), and `server/notification/email.go` (5). Authentication is what gives `User` its extra reach — `server/auth` resolves the current user on every request, and the file server needs it for avatars.
- `store.Memo`: `server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/runner/memopayload`, plus test-only `server/router/api/v1/test` and `server/router/rss` (only `rss_test.go` in the latter). Top files are `server/notification/email.go` (10), `server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go` and `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go` (5 each).

One caveat on the counts: `store.IdentityProvider`, `store.UserSetting`, and `store.InstanceSetting` show zero outside references not because they're unused, but because callers outside the data layer work with the protobuf equivalents (`storepb.IdentityProvider`, `storepb.UserSetting`, `storepb.InstanceSetting`) instead of the store structs. Also, these are textual reference counts rather than a type-checked usage graph, so treat the totals as approximate; the package-level ranking is unaffected since the gap between first and second place is clear.
